stylePrefix: Flat vector editorial illustration with a subtle paper-grain, gouache-textured finish. Warm muted editorial palette: coral-salmon red, petrol teal-blue, mustard golden-yellow, cream off-white, plum purple, and muted slate-blue and grey. Stylised human characters with simple rounded or elongated heads, small round dot eyes, a prominent angular nose in profile, thin minimal limbs, flat solid-colour clothing, warm terracotta skin tones. One clear conceptual metaphor, generous negative space, a flat single-colour textured background, soft small drop shadows. Whimsical, intelligent, calm, dry-witted business-editorial mood. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words, logos, watermark, or signature.

examples.concept: The myth / the thing everyone reveres
examples.subject: two tiny figures stand on a blue mountain peak looking up at a very large coral-salmon monolithic head in profile, like a stone idol

examples.concept: The audience / who is actually listening
examples.subject: a small group sit in a circle around a campfire at night, with a calm bear sitting among them as if listening; small cream moon and scattered stars
one figure in a white coat stands among a large field of overlapping flat circles in greys and teals, holding up the single bright mustard circle they have just found

examples.concept: The proof / the number that lands

a dense field of small grey scribbles fills the frame, and one figure holds up a single clean bright coral shape pulled out of it
a tangled knot of looping lines on the left resolves left-to-right into one clean straight line, a small figure walking alongside
two figures shake hands across a gap between two separate platforms, the handshake forming the bridge
a small figure pushes a large plain boulder up a gentle slope, a flat sun-like circle waiting over the crest
one figure speaks into a large simple broadcast horn, flat concentric arcs rippling outward to several tiny distant figures
an oversized flat hourglass dominates the frame, sand part-run-through, a small calm figure sitting on its base reading
a figure holds a large simple magnifying glass over a small flat object; through the lens it appears far larger and brighter coral
a calm figure carries a small contained flame away from a shrinking blaze
two figures release a paper aeroplane from a rooftop into a rising current
one figure holds an oversized microphone toward another mid-gesture
a small figure reaches up to touch one bar on a huge simple chart
a figure on a tall podium, smaller figures below turning to look up

examples.concept: The team behind the visible work
examples.subject: one lit figure stands on a platform held up by four others
one pebble dropped in water, figures standing on each widening ripple

three figures push a wheel already turning; one steps back, hands off

a figure steps from a straight path onto a new one branching sharply
a shouting crowd; one quiet figure holds up a small lantern
a figure steps through a doorway; grey and angular one side, warm and round the other
six figures on separate islands, connected by lines they each hold

examples.concept: The long tail outlasts the spike

a figure steps through a clean round hole in a thick wall, warm light pouring in
